newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bremen state sells stake in local bank to NordLB.
newsitem.headline: Bremen state sells stake in local bank to NordLB.

text.p: The city state of Bremen has decided to sell a 17.5 percent stake in regional bank Bremer Landesbank (BLB) to Norddeutsche Landesbank (NordLB), which already owns 75 percent of the Bremen bank, a government spokesman said on Wednesday.
The sale will yield 222.5 million marks for the state. The money will partly be used to cover risks resulting from the bankruptcy of shipbuilder Bremer Vulkan AG last year.
Bremen provided the shipbuilder with substantial credit guarantees but was unable to prevent its collapse.
Bremen will retain a 7.5 percent stake in BLB because it wants to keep a say in the bank, the spokesman said.
